Overview

Wa is a city in Upper West with a population of 120,000. The capital of the Upper West Region, a growing city in Ghana’s savannah region known for its unique culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
